behavior.label: Ignore / omit on export
behavior.description: Do not include a layer or group in the target export.

target.note: Spine import ignores target and descendants.
Generator has no standalone ignore directive. An ordinary layer name without asset filename will not itself trigger an asset.
Krita exporter excludes the layer; native OCA writer omits it.

authoring.note: Comp-IO directive. Exclude this layer or Collection subtree from additional artwork exports.

behavior.caution: Spine [ignore] can preserve a visible PSD reference, whereas excluding a layer from the PSD removes it completely.

behavior.label: Reference / guide artwork
behavior.description: Keep for the artist but mark non-rendering/non-exporting downstream.

target.note: Spine has no reference tag; [ignore] stops importer from creating an attachment.
No Generator reference directive; keep a normal hidden layer without a Generator filename.
Krita OCA exporter marks a reference; native OCA layer.reference=true.

authoring.note: Comp-IO directive. Keep as a hidden reference in PSD or mark reference artwork in OCA.

behavior.caution: Reference artwork can remain available as a guide. Spine [ignore] omits it on import, while OCA marks it as reference content.

behavior.label: Merge a group into one paint layer
behavior.description: Comp-IO rasterizes a tagged Blender Collection into one PSD/OCA pixel layer. Its name comes from the group, with .merge removed. Multiple child render layers are composited in their stack order.

target.note: Spine [merge] asks its importer to flatten an existing PSD group. Comp-IO .merge is applied during PSD creation, resulting in one paint layer.
Generator flattens a group only into a generated asset file; it does not change the PSD layer hierarchy.
Krita OCA export can flatten tagged groups. Comp-IO writes already merged pixels in native OCA.

authoring.note: Comp-IO directive on a Blender Collection. Rasterizes its contents into one paint layer in PSD/PSB and OCA. On an individual output layer it only removes the directive from the displayed name.

behavior.caution: Comp-IO merges cached pixels without changing Blender geometry. Mixed group blend modes can look different after flattening when they depend on backdrop artwork outside the group. Test complex compositing before delivery.

behavior.label: Preserve layer hierarchy
behavior.description: Keep authored parent/child grouping.

target.note: Spine [folder] controls the attachment output directory. PSD groups retain their own hierarchy.
Generator can use any group for compositing but does not use arbitrary folder names as paths.
Native OCA expresses groups structurally; no naming tag required.

authoring.note: Comp-IO Collection directive. Omit this container from PSD/OCA and promote its contents to the nearest retained ancestor.

behavior.caution: Group membership must preserve original draw order; noncontiguous hierarchy needs split group instances.

behavior.label: Hidden / initial visibility
behavior.description: Preserve artwork but open it hidden.

target.note: Spine can optionally ignore hidden layers on import.
Photoshop Generator follows the normal layer visibility settings when producing assets.
No OCA name tag needed.
